@graph.name: How Can I Store Leftover Creamy Garlic Chicken Breasts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Store your leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 3-4 days and reheat in a pan over medium heat or in the microwave, pausing at every 15 second interval. You may also need to add a splash of milk or chicken broth to get the sauce back to the right consistency.

@graph.name: Can I Try This With Another Protein?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can! I love the idea of trying this recipe with shrimp, steaks and even salmon. Just remember that the cooking time will be different depending on the kind of meat you’re working with.

@graph.name: Creamy Garlic Chicken Breast Recipe
@graph.description: Lightly floured boneless chicken breasts are pan fried until golden and crispy before being added to a mouth-watering garlic cream sauce!
recipeIngredient: 2-3  boneless chicken breasts (large, skinless, halved horizontally to make 4)
1 whole head of garlic (peeled and divided into 10-12 cloves)
1 1/4 cup heavy cream (half and half (or evaporated milk))

recipeInstructions.text: Season the chicken with salt, garlic powder and pepper.
recipeInstructions.name: Season the chicken with salt, garlic powder and pepper.

recipeInstructions.text: In a shallow bowl, combine the flour, parmesan cheese. Dredge chicken in the flour mixture; shake off excess.
recipeInstructions.name: In a shallow bowl, combine the flour, parmesan cheese. Dredge chicken in the flour mixture; shake off excess.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Swirl pan to coat evenly.
recipeInstructions.name: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Swirl pan to coat evenly.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry 2-3 chicken breasts until golden on each side, cooked through and no longer pink (about 4-5 minutes each side, depending on the thickness of your chicken). Transfer to a warm plate. Set aside.
recipeInstructions.name: Fry 2-3 chicken breasts until golden on each side, cooked through and no longer pink (about 4-5 minutes each side, depending on the thickness of your chicken). Transfer to a warm plate. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.text: Wipe pan over with a sheet of paper towel. Repeat with remaining oil, butter and chicken breasts. When cooked, transfer the chicken onto the same plate.
recipeInstructions.name: Wipe pan over with a sheet of paper towel. Repeat with remaining oil, butter and chicken breasts. When cooked, transfer the chicken onto the same plate.

recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium. Sauté the onion in the remaining oil/juices in the pan until softened.
recipeInstructions.name: Reduce heat to medium. Sauté the onion in the remaining oil/juices in the pan until softened.

recipeInstructions.text: Smash 6 whole cloves of garlic with the blunt edge of the back of a knife
recipeInstructions.name: Smash 6 whole cloves of garlic with the blunt edge of the back of a knife

recipeInstructions.text: Add the remaining oil and butter to the pan and heat through, mixing it through the onions. Sauté smashed garlic cloves and whole garlic cloves until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes. Add the broth to deglaze the pan. Scrape up any browned bits and let simmer and reduce to half, about 5 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the remaining oil and butter to the pan and heat through, mixing it through the onions. Sauté smashed garlic cloves and whole garlic cloves until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes. Add the broth to deglaze the pan. Scrape up any browned bits and let simmer and reduce to half, about 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour in the cream. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer for about 2-3 minutes, combining all of the flavours together.
recipeInstructions.name: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour in the cream. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer for about 2-3 minutes, combining all of the flavours together.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix in the parmesan cheese. Continue cooking gently for about 2-3 minutes until cheese melts, while stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper to your taste.
recipeInstructions.name: Mix in the parmesan cheese. Continue cooking gently for about 2-3 minutes until cheese melts, while stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper to your taste.

recipeInstructions.text: Add the chicken back into the pan and let simmer for a further 2-3 minutes to thicken the sauce to your liking. The chicken breast will soak up all of the delicious flavours.

recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with parsley and a little black cracked pepper. Serve over pasta, cauliflower mash, zucchini noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.
